Academic and Degree Programs
Explore academic offerings at the Levin College of Public Affairs and Education where we offer a wide range of coursework and degrees designed to prepare students for meaningful careers in public service, education, and more. Our comprehensive curriculum, experienced faculty, and hands-on learning opportunities ensure that you are well-equipped to make a difference in your community and the world. Discover the diverse academic paths available to you.
Learn more about our degrees programs from Levin College's Department of Criminology and Sociology, Maxine Goodman Levin School of Urban Affairs, School of Communication, and School of Education and Counseling below.
Department of Criminology and Sociology
Our Department of Criminology and Sociology applies an interdisciplinary approach to major social issues, contributing to societal transformation, facilitating greater well-being, enhancing public safety, and maximizing our impact in our community and beyond.
Our faculty and curriculum equip students with the analytical and critical thinking skills necessary to work in a wide variety of career settings, including government agencies, nonprofit organizations, social and community service organizations, and health services.
Students study a wide variety of topics including social inequality, criminology, gender, race, ethnicity, and law, while developing research skills and the ability to understand and connect individual lives with wider social forces.

Maxine Goodman Levin School of Urban Affairs
Our Maxine Goodman Levin School of Urban Affairs is recognized as one of the best public affairs schools in the nation by U.S. News & World Report. The School is ranked 3rd in the U.S. in the specialty of Urban Policy and 10th in the specialty of Local Government Management.
The School offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional development programs in fields that guide and advance vibrant and sustainable communities, including urban studies, public administration, urban planning, environmental studies, nonprofit management, and organizational leadership.
Our collection of scholars combines practical experience with research and theory, delivering excellence in teaching to prepare the next generation of community leaders. We are committed to the advancement of cities through sustainable and equitable economic and social development, and we work toward this goal daily through our research, education, and public service.

School of Communication
Our School of Communication is a dynamic community of students, faculty, and staff that exemplify the traditional university missions of teaching, research, and service, while engaging with the community.
Our faculty bring real-world expertise to the classroom, deepening our students understanding of theory and best practices reflective of the field of communication today, while providing real-life application of skills through hands-on learning opportunities. We infuse experiential learning throughout our classroom teaching, placing emphasis on current and emerging digital trends to prepare students with the skills necessary to succeed in fast-growing career fields.
Students in our School of Communication are equipped with a foundation in strategic communications and digital communications practices. They learn to interpret research and data and communicate it in an effective way; strategize, plan, execute, and evaluate ethical and effective communication; and navigate real-world communication challenges that organizations face today.

School of Education and Counseling
The School of Education and Counseling is a hub of educational leadership, innovation, and excellence at Levin College. We are dedicated to shaping the next generation of educators and counselors who make a meaningful impact in their fields.
Teaching Licensure Programs
Our licensure programs prepare aspiring teachers for a variety of educational settings. These programs are thoughtfully designed to provide the skills and knowledge necessary for success in today’s diverse classrooms. Whether you're pursuing undergraduate or graduate licensure, our programs offer comprehensive training for new and experienced educators.
Education and Counseling Graduate Programs
We offer a wide array of graduate degree and certificate programs in counseling, educational leadership, and adult, professional, & higher education. Through real-world learning experiences, our students are well-equipped for careers in school districts, healthcare organizations, and higher education institutions.
Doctoral Program
Our doctoral program fosters advanced research and leadership in education. With a focus on educational innovation and inquiry, this program prepares leaders to influence educational policy, research, and practice at the highest levels.
